confirmar.detalle: The unfinished game will be abandoned and can't be continued.
confirmar.detalleRonda: The unfinished game (round {{ronda}}) will be abandoned and can't be continued.

errores.largo: Names can't be longer than {{max}} characters.

reglas.jugadores: 2 to 8 players, sharing a single phone that gets passed around. Everyone starts with 3 lives.
reglas.turno: On your turn you roll 5 dice. Between rolls, tap any dice you want to hold (or release): held dice aren't rolled again.
reglas.abrir: Whoever opens the round can roll up to 3 times. The number of rolls they use is the limit for everyone else that round.
reglas.plantarse: When you stand, your hand is all 5 dice.
reglas.desempate: With the same hand, the higher value wins: three 5s beat three 3s.
reglas.comodines: <0>1s are wild</0>: they join your largest group (on a tie, the higher one). They don't count towards a straight.
reglas.perder: The worst hand of the round loses a life. On a tie, whoever played later loses. The player who loses the life opens the next round.
reglas.fin: The game ends when someone runs out of lives: that player is the loser.

partida.estadoInesperado: The game is in an unexpected state

pasarMovil.abresRonda_one: You open the round: you can roll up to {{count}} time.
pasarMovil.abresRonda_other: You open the round: you can roll up to {{count}} times.

peorTirada.vacia: Nobody has played yet this round.

turno.sinJugada: Your hand will show up here

ayuda.sinTiradas: No rolls left: time to stand.
ayuda.todosGuardados: You're holding every die: release one to roll again, or stand.
ayuda.guardar: Tap a die to hold or release it. Held dice aren't rolled again.

jugadaActual.peor: Right now you'd be the worst hand

castigos: The next round is on you (of whatever).
Everyone else picks the music for the next hour.
Tell a bad joke. The others decide if it counts.
Do a chicken impression for ten seconds.
You pick the next movie… from a list the others make for you.
You're serving drinks until the rematch.
